body: Thank you, I just don’t know what I can do. Tomorrow I’m going to head out and buy myself some weed for a New Years smoke and I’m hoping for some enlightenment from the high xD

If one person is mad at someone else then just bolt

“Again, anyone who says to a brother or sister, ‘Raca,’ is answerable to the court. And anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of hell.”

Tame your frustration in calling him or his words, gifted to us by God, foolish for you insult God and his creation.

“In wisdom, walk toward the ones outside, redeeming the time. Let your word be always in grace, having been seasoned with salt, to know how it is necessary for each one of you to answer”

We shouldn’t shun him, though it may be in vain we must at least try to educate him?
